tier2.headline: Your data is kept forever
tier2.quote: We consider our relationship with the MIT community to be lifelong.

tier2.headline: Your data goes to the US
tier2.quote: By providing information directly to MIT, you consent to the transfer of your personal information outside of the European Economic Area to the United States.

tier2.headline: Your deletion has limits
tier2.quote: Upon a request to erase information, we will maintain a core set of personal data to ensure we do not contact you inadvertently in the future, as well as any information necessary for MIT archival purposes.
